verdict: E-Q28 VERDICT (does deterministic code-side selection over typed-map embeddings STEER generation? — mutation=DeepSeek under gap-derived directives, selection=the evosphere DO's coordinated dual-JEV gate, heredity=accepted lineage, environment=LIVE Vectorize eq22N, control=the sealed E-Q24 walk): H1 DIES — the gated process covered all 4 families in 6 stations vs the control walk's 5: selection did NOT compress coverage (N1->Q4->N4->P4->P2->A5); C24 DIES on H1 — THE DECOUPLING LAW: family-centroid cosine and top-1 retrieval family are DIFFERENT objectives. The gen-2 mutant reached 0.8724 cosine to the P centroid yet its top-1 retrieval landed N4(N) — the latent hill was climbed while the retrieval geometry refused to flip; directed hill-climbing overshot into centroid regions whose record neighborhoods did not change family. The undirected walk's compounding residuals were, on this corpus, the MORE coverage-efficient mover. BUT the steering is real and measured on every other instrument: H2 LIVES decisively (5/10 rejections — a 0.50 acceptance rate — with discrimination 0.1974 accepted vs -0.1077 rejected: the gate discriminates, not decorates); H3 LIVES (coordination 0.8 — and TWO SPLIT-REJECTIONS where jev-latest alone would have accepted and only the preview model's decline refused the mutant: the coordinated gate made rejections a single-model gate COULD NOT, the k=2 independence pattern's first live use as a selection pressure); H4 LIVES (heredity mean 0.9273 — the directed mutants stay as grounded as the walk's notes 0.93-0.98: direction did not cost grounding). THE DIRECTIVE IS CAUSAL (P6): named-axis movement 0.43 vs unnamed 0.2197 — the gap-derived concepts moved the axes they named ~2x harder than the axes they did not. THE ESCAPE RULE WAS LOAD-BEARING: generations 3-4 stagnated on the P target (4 consecutive rejects at the 0.87 fitness ledge), the pre-registered rotation fired at gen 5 (P->A), and the A-directed run crossed P territory in transit (the accepted gen-5 note retrieved P4 — coverage of P arrived as a SIDE EFFECT of moving toward A). THE ECONOMICS RECEIPT: 21 embed calls + 10 generator calls for 6 stations vs the walk's 8+7 for 8 — direction costs ~2.6x the measurement per station. THE ARTIFACT: the evosphere Durable Object (selection-as-infrastructure) — the protocol, the append-only attempt log, and the frozen centroids live as code in a DO that never calls a model (the jev-lattice law applied to evolution); the full world state is the receipt.
